turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.

I can help you start a tattoo booking. Please tell me: 1) the idea or design you have in mind, 2) the approximate size, 3) where on the body you want it, and 4) your availability (dates or times that suit you). A colleague will then take over the booking, as I cannot confirm prices or dates.
The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.

Thank you. I have passed your booking details to a colleague: a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of your left forearm, available on weekday evenings. A colleague will take over from here and get back to you about the booking.

input.summary: Customer wants a tattoo booking. Idea: small paper boat. Size: about 8 cm wide. Placement: outside of left forearm. Availability: weekday evenings. No price or date given or promised.
